scope: Linked fixed checkpoint; eight fitting bridges only; no optimizer, heldout remapping, collection or intervention.
normalization: Latent squared L2 averaged over all eight candidates and twelve steps, divided by 2*s2_bundle; support negative log averaged over the two physical histories; roots averaged before assignment minimum.
geometry_limit: Official linear XY probe of predicted latents is diagnostic; true XY computed only from existing issued menu controls via unchanged OpenPhysics equations. It is not a candidate ranking result.
far_probe_omission_limit: Skips only the two far east/west diagnostic arrivals; later actual recovery and neutral arrivals still update support.
combined_normalization: One half of (existing menu energy including endpoint support penalty + actual first-H1 source squared error divided by 2*s2_obs), then average endpoints and histories before one common permutation minimum. No postwrite H1 penalty is added.
